links.comparator_used: Manufacturer-provided baseline model used as supplied (off-the-shelf) before local tuning
links.outcome: Rectum sparing (rectum V50 Gy) and plan consistency of automatically generated prostate plans
links.effect: Baseline model had inferior rectum sparing to human plans. After two tuning iterations rectum sparing was comparable (0.02 mean difference in rectum V50 Gy) while much of the improved consistency was kept.
links.tradeoff: Only much, not all, of the improved consistency was maintained. Tuning needed two further model iterations produced in collaboration with the manufacturer.
links.quote: Further iterations of the model resulted in comparable rectum sparing, a 0.02 mean difference in rectum V50 Gy, was achieved whilst maintaining much of the improved consistency.

design_hint: local commissioning, model tuning, and control-chart monitoring of plan quality
